simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to בַּרְקָן (H1303) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: בַּרְקָן (barqân) means a thorn (perhaps as burning brightly) First listed occurrence: Judg 8 7.

definitions.full: H1303. barqanim בַּרְקָנִים noun masculine plural briers (so Vrss Ki and others, also Stu q. v., Be, v unknown; compare || קוֺצִים ; > JDMich, Thes and others threshing-sledges , furnished with sharp ( glittering ) stones) Judg 8:7 וְאֶתהַֿבּ הַמִּדְבָּר אֶתקֿוֺצֵי ׳אֶתבְּֿשַׂרְכֶם וְדַשְׁתִּ֫י (see also דושׁ ) and I will thresh your flesh together with the thorns of the wilderness and the briers ; 8:16 סֻכּוֺת אַנְשֵׁי אֵת בָּהֶם הַבּ וְאֶת הַמִּדְבָּר וְאֶתקֿוֺצֵי הָעִיר אֶתזִֿקְנֵי ׳וַיִּקַּח וַיֹּדַע (read וַיָּדָשׁ for ᵐ5 וַיֹּדַע Bu RS 114 ; compare Stu Be) and he took the thorns of the wilderness and the briers and threshed , etc.
